scope_note: Complete illustrative method semantics for adaptation. No source, installed, runtime, permission or project-completeness claim.

modules.purpose: Own inventory reservations and their durable operation outcomes.

inputs.name: request_id
inputs.false: Reject BadInput; bool is not UUID.

inputs.name: quantity
inputs.false: Reject BadInput; bool is not int for this contract.

inputs.name: expires_in_seconds
inputs.omitted: Use 60 seconds from the confirmed transaction clock.
inputs.null: Create a non-expiring reservation if caller has reserve_permanent authority; otherwise reject Forbidden before mutation.
inputs.false: Reject BadInput; false is not null or integer 0.

inputs.name: allow_partial
inputs.false: Require the full quantity; insufficient stock gives a known no-effect error. True permits a positive partial reservation. Zero units never produce a committed reservation.

output.raw_return: Return the declared result unchanged; no transport envelope or coercion.

errors.retry: Correct input; preserve request identity rules.

errors.when: Caller lacks inventory.write or requested permanent reservation authority.
errors.retry: Only after a qualified authority change; never fabricate a role.

errors.when: Full requested quantity unavailable with allow_partial false, or zero available.
errors.retry: No blind loop; a changed stock condition is required.

errors.when: Same request_id with different canonical inputs or owner.
errors.retry: Do not allocate a new ID to disguise the collision.
Observe exact request_id first; no mutation retry inside this scenario.

auth.role: inventory.write; inventory.reserve_permanent only for explicit null expiry
auth.tenant: Caller-owned tenant context; body does not assign tenant or authority
auth.credentials: Not part of this method registry

effects.transaction: Validate ownership and inputs; lock item; record reservation, stock change and request outcome atomically. Return COMMITTED only after confirmed commit.

idempotency.same_inputs: Return the durable original ReservationResult with replayed true; no additional reservation or stock change.
idempotency.different_inputs: IdempotencyConflict; never silently reinterpret the request.
idempotency.unknown: Call example.inventory.observe@1 with the same caller/tenant/request_id; missing observation does not authorize a resend.

methods.runtime_identity: Synthetic names only; bind actual existing return/exception identities before adapting to a real project.

fields.name: result
fields.null_meaning: Absent unless a matching committed outcome is qualified.

output.semantics: COMMITTED requires matching durable request/caller/tenant and result. CONFIRMED_NO_EFFECT requires a definitive terminal operation record. No record, unavailable read or an in-flight outcome means UNKNOWN. Never infer no effect from null/missing result.

errors.when: Caller/tenant does not own observation scope.

auth.caller: Original caller or explicitly authorized read-only operator

effects.transaction: Read exact operation identity; no create/resend/release/repair.

idempotency.same_inputs: Repeated read may observe a later durable state; each observation retains its own time.
idempotency.unknown: Remain UNKNOWN until positive qualified evidence; no implicit mutation.

methods.runtime_identity: Synthetic return and exception names only; actual identity binding is required.

preconditions: Original request_id is fixed before the first invocation.

steps.bind: Exact declared request parameters; preserve omitted/null/false.

postconditions: Return a qualified committed reservation if observed.
Known no-effect error or CONFIRMED_NO_EFFECT ends this scenario without automatic mutation retry.
UNKNOWN remains held with the same request identity.
composites.state_owner: Existing example.inventory repository only; no composite ledger or scheduler.
